title: Making EUV: from lab to fab

passages.note: The dawn of EUV, Toward industrialization, and First prototype to first light. The supplier history places Kinoshita’s proof in mid-1980s Japan, identifies development across Japan, the US and Europe, and traces the 2006 Alpha Demo Tools, 2010 pre-production NXE:3100 shipment to a Samsung research facility, and 2013 eye toward production with NXE:3300.
